productivityWidgets.composition: Initial setup created three native tasks and configured Tomorrow, then its first post-configuration tap failed. A settled fresh tap passed; no production routing change was made and the initial cause remains unproven. Native estimate/completion edits then persisted, but the refresh test encountered a transient third SpringBoard widget icon that disappeared before sorting its frame. The query now excludes missing elements. A resumed checkpoint verified the changed counts, exact routes and relaunch. This is composed evidence, not an all-green setup-to-finish driver run.
productivityWidgets.layout: Small capacity uses a short heading with explicit Today/Tomorrow, and reserves two-line height for the budget qualifier and estimate/overdue explanation. Project pulse uses singular needs for one attention item.

Use inspected pixels plus native outcomes; this does not establish VoiceOver coverage.
productivityWidgets.privacy: Native project-name and capacity-detail privacy switches work independently. Both exact routes still open the updated fixture; both settings restore to false. Inspected hidden/restored pixels confirm Studio is concealed and capacity details are concealed. Pulse progress/attention counts intentionally remain visible when names are hidden. Small pulse does not render task titles, so task-title privacy in larger sizes remains unverified.
